notes.title: Sunday Gold Out Now!
notes.content:
[h1]IT’S TIME TO PULL OFF THE PERFECT CRIME AS SUNDAY GOLD LAUNCHES ON STEAM TODAY[/h1]

[b]BKOM Studios’ latest title combines point and click adventuring with stylish turn-based combat splashed against the backdrop of a dystopian 2070s London.[/b]

Team17 and BKOM Studios, in collaboration with the Canadian Media Fund (CMF) have today launched dystopian point and click adventure Sunday Gold on Steam for PC. Set in a crime and corruption ridden, near-future London, Sunday Gold follows an unlikely trio – Frank (aka ‘The Vengeful Ex-Con’), Sally (aka ‘The Activist’), and Gavin (aka ‘The Disgruntled Ex-Employee’) – as they pull off the job of their criminally disastrous careers. Integrating classic adventure gameplay with turn-based combat, Sunday Gold follows the gang as they harness their unique abilities, including lock picking and computer hacking, to help infiltrate the bloody underbelly of corrupt corporation Hogan Industries and bring down its monstrous boss.

 
[b]We only have one shot to pull this off, don’t mess it up.[/b]

[previewyoutube=xMfymYTg7Ow;full][/previewyoutube]

In addition to its unique blend of gameplay, Sunday Gold features stylish comic book style art and animation inspired by a visual concept developed by artists at Quebecois studio VOLTA, alongside amazing audio and atmospheric music from PVL Audio


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42514471/4345d46714dfdf737700cceb0535bedac9239c42.jpg[/img]


[b]Sunday Gold Key Features:[/b]

[list]
[*] [b]Atmospheric action[/b]: Immersed in the gritty and unwelcoming world of a dystopian near-future London, Sunday Gold’s story takes players into the seedy underbelly of the corrupt elite, where secrets are hidden behind every locked door

[*] [b]Stylish turn-based combat[/b]: Comic book inspired sequences, unique skills, attacks, and talent trees, along with as many stolen items the trio can get their thievin’ hands on, make for a unique turn-based combat experience

[*] [b]Noggin’ scratching puzzles[/b]: Explore each room and solve a combination of observation, deduction, and inventory puzzles; hunt for clues, hack terminals, and even bust down a door (or two)

[*] [b]Keep your cool[/b]: In the face of dead bodies, cybernetic dogs, and psychotic billionaires even the most hardened criminals will start to lose their cool – maintaining the team’s composure with consumables and specific abilities will be key to mission success

[*] [b]A trio of trouble[/b]: Frank, Sally, and Gavin make for unusual comrades, but without each of their unique abilities to lock pick, hack, and rip things open with their bare hands, the mission is doomed to fail.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42514471/22468d0c1fef16b8c20a160d39c9146ee532ac69.jpg[/img]


Sunday Gold is available to purchase on Steam, with the free-to-play prologue currently on Steam  for those wanting to check if a life of crime suits them first.

notes.title: Sunday Gold Game Features
notes.content:
[h1]Listen up![/h1]

It's time to take you through some of the nitty gritty details of Sunday Gold! What you'll be doing, how the game will play and what you can expect from this genre-melding game!


[h3]Core Gameplay Elements[/h3]

[list]
[*] Adventure gameplay - Work your way through dystopian London, exploring beautifully crafted scenes and their numerous points of interest.

[*] Observation, deduction, and inventory puzzles - Pay attention to your surroundings. There is plenty to discover as you delve deeper into the story.

[*] Cinematic narrative moments - Experience the story through engaging clips, that help drive the story forward.

[*] Character development via conversations - Learn more about your rag-tag band of miscreants. What  are their motivations? What makes them tick?
 
[*] Unique character abilities - Each member of the team comes equipped with their own set of skills and abilities. Ensure you make use of everything at your disposal.

[*] Hero inventory and skill management - Level up and gain new abilities, enhance your power in combat and shape the team into the perfect squad.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42514471/18da000f850ca8f12aa2a27d42374fb4578d05fd.jpg[/img]


[h3]Turn-Based Combat[/h3]

[list]
[*] 3 heroes with different fighting styles and unique abilities - Frank's lockpicking, Sally's strenght and Gavin's computer know-how. You'll need them all to see this one through to the end.

[*] Strategic choices impact the player’s ability to prevail - Make sure you get it right! Failing too many times might keep that door you're working on, locked.

[*] Enemies with unique capabilities - Pay attention to your opponents, this ain't gonna be a walk in the park after all.

[*] Weapons and gear to collect that can be used to customize the heroes and adapt to challenges - A variety of tools and weapons are at your disposal. Make sure you're ready for what's ahead.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42514471/4345d46714dfdf737700cceb0535bedac9239c42.jpg[/img]

[h3]Composure management[/h3]

[list]
[*] The heroes’ composure state is affected by the events that they experience - We're only human after all. Try and keep the team calm and collected, or their panic could work against you.

[*] Their composure state affects their capacity to perform in both aspects of gameplay - Fail to keep people on track and you'll be in for a rough time.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42514471/e90f1636d5b5d4d5e1eee82bfb70141485ae6f61.jpg[/img]

notes.title: DISCOVER SUNDAY GOLD!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42514471/1e39abf6c96dabe8a3119f234037119cb5faad57.png[/img]

Sunday Gold is a point-and-click, turn-based adventure game set in a grim and dystopian future London. Play as a ragtag trio of criminals to hunt down and expose the dark secrets of an evil mega-corporation and the malevolent billionaire behind it. 

[previewyoutube=BFwBInavwJY;full][/previewyoutube]

[h1]About this game[/h1]

Experience a unique hybrid of escape room style puzzles, turn-based combat, and RPG mechanics tied together with a dark and cinematic storyline. 

[b]Delve into the dark underbelly of near-future London[/b]
Once bustling and full of life, the city of London is in a dark and dismal state. Unemployment and homelessness are at an all-time high. Ethical boundaries are being stretched to their limit and corrupt billionaire, Kenny Hogan, is up to no good. 

It’s up to ragtag band of criminals Frank, Sally, and Gavin, to put a wrench in Kenny Hogan’s plans and bring him to his knees. But this is no simple job and there’ll be a smattering of obstacles they’ll have to face along the way… 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42514471/22468d0c1fef16b8c20a160d39c9146ee532ac69.jpg[/img]

[h1]Features[/h1]

[b]Lose yourself in a dark and dystopian story[/b]
Immerse yourself in a gritty and graphic world with a storyline narrated by fully voice-acted characters. Experience stunningly hand-drawn environments, 2D cinematics and comic book inspired sequences as well as cliff hangers that will keep you on your toes.

[b]Puzzles that will get you scratching your noggin[/b] 
Explore each room and solve a combination of observation, deduction, and inventory puzzles to progress on your mission. Hunt for clues, hack terminals, bust down a door (or two) and test your wits in mini game challenges unique to each “hero”. 

[b]Stylish turn-based combat inspired by comic books[/b]
Face off against your opponents in stylish and cinematic RPG style battles. Each team member possesses their own unique set of skills as well as their own strengths and weaknesses. Plan your moves strategically, master winning combos and kick your enemies to the curb. 

[b]Keep your composure and try not to sweat[/b]
Battle your own stress levels as well as enemies! Disturbing and pressured situations will wear down your characters’ composure causing them to act impulsively. Maintain your composure with consumables and leadership abilities. Lose your mind, lose the mission!

[b]A modern twist on point-and-click games[/b] 
Sunday Gold takes the traditional elements of a point-and-click game and mixes them with fierce RPG combat and a gritty storyline.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42514471/4345d46714dfdf737700cceb0535bedac9239c42.jpg[/img]
